$comment: LCARdS 2026.10.0-dev.3: generated from src/cards/schemas/ by scripts/generate-llm-schema.js; do not hand-edit.
title: LCARdS Slider Card Configuration
description: Complete configuration schema for lcards-slider custom card

sounds.description: Per-card sound configuration. Overrides global sound settings for this card.

enabled.description: Whether this card fires sounds. Set to false to completely silence this card. Default: true (omit to keep default).

card_tap.description: Asset key for card tap, or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

card_hold.description: Asset key for card hold, or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

card_double_tap.description: Asset key for card double-tap, or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

card_hover.description: Asset key for card hover (desktop), or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

slider_drag_start.description: Asset key for slider grab, or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

slider_change.description: Asset key for slider value change, or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

slider_drag_end.description: Asset key for slider release, or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

toggle_on.description: Asset key for toggle-on, or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

toggle_off.description: Asset key for toggle-off, or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

variables.description: Your own named values, available to templates as variables.<name> and {variables.<name>}.

zones.description: Named rectangles (px or *_percent of the card) that text fields and animations can target.

debug_zones.description: Outline every zone on the card (development aid).

data_sources.description: Data sources for real-time entity tracking, historical data, and processing pipelines. Each key defines a named data source accessible in templates.
data_sources.$comment: Data sources enable entity subscriptions, history preload, and unified processing pipeline

attribute.description: Entity attribute to track instead of state

enum_mapping.description: Map non-numeric states to numbers so they can be plotted or processed (on/off map to 1/0 automatically)

hours.description: Hours of history to preload (1-168, default: 6)

processing.description: Processing pipeline with named processors. Each processor transforms data and stores results in a buffer accessible via templates.

input_source.description: Name of another processor in this pipeline whose output this one reads (creates a dependency chain). If omitted, uses the raw entity value.

enabled.description: Set false to pass values through unchanged (default true)

from.description: convert_unit: source unit (e.g. c, f, w, kw). Not a chaining key: use input_source.

method.description: smooth: exponential | moving_average | gaussian. round: round | floor | ceil

alpha.description: smooth (exponential): weight of the newest value, 0 to 1 (default 0.3)

window.description: smooth: sample count (default 10). statistics: time window like "5m" or "session"

expression.description: expression: JavaScript expression using value/v, t, sources, entity and Math helpers

sources.description: expression: processor names available as sources[0], sources[1], ...

stats.description: statistics: min, max, mean, median, std_dev, q1, q3, range, count, sum

max_points.description: statistics: keep a time series of this many results

samples.description: trend: samples in the slope window (default 5)

threshold.description: trend: slope below which the trend is stable. threshold: switch point

hysteresis.description: threshold: dead band around the switch point

condition.description: duration: condition like "> 20" that starts the timer

reset_on.description: duration: condition that resets the timer

window_seconds.description: Rolling buffer window: seconds, or a duration like "5m" or "1h". About 10 points per second are kept, at most 1,000 (default 60)

min_emit_ms.description: Minimum ms between updates sent to cards (throttle, default 100)

coalesce_ms.description: Window in ms for merging rapid changes into one update (default: 40% of min_emit_ms, at least 20)

max_delay_ms.description: Longest ms an update may be held back while merging (default: 3 x coalesce_ms)

emit_on_same_value.description: Send updates even when the value did not change (default true)

items.description: Entity ID whose state change should trigger a re-render

triggers_update.description: Extra entity IDs to watch for state changes. When any listed entity changes, all templates on this card are re-evaluated. Use this for JavaScript templates ([[[...]]]) that reference entities LCARdS cannot detect automatically via static analysis.

entity.description: Home Assistant entity ID to control or monitor (format: domain.object_id)

ranges_attribute.description: Entity attribute to use as the numeric value for all range conditions (above:/below:/between: keys) in any state-based style config. Use "brightness_pct" for a computed 0–100 light brightness value. Defaults to evaluating the raw entity state string.

state_attribute.description: Entity attribute whose String() value is used as the highest-priority key for ALL exact-match state-color lookups across the card. Booleans become "true"/"false"; null becomes "null"; strings are used as-is. Classified state (active/inactive) is always derived from entity.state and is unaffected. Can be used alongside ranges_attribute.

state_classification.description: Override how raw entity states are mapped to style buckets. Use built-in buckets (active/inactive/default) or define your own named buckets. Explicit state keys in style config always take priority over this.

active.description: Additional states to classify as "active" (augments the built-in active list).

else.description: Bucket for states not matched by any list (built-in or custom). Accepts built-in bucket names (active/inactive/default) or a custom bucket name. Defaults to "inactive" when omitted.

additionalProperties.description: Custom bucket: an array of raw entity states that map to this bucket name.

id.description: Unique card identifier for rule targeting, animations, and debugging (alphanumeric, underscore, hyphen)

tags.description: Tags for bulk rule targeting and grouping. Allows applying rules to multiple cards at once using tag selectors.

oneOf.description: Card height in pixels (bare integer, e.g. 56 = 56px)
Card height with CSS unit (e.g. 200px, 50vh, 10em) or a CSS function: calc(), min(), max(), clamp(), var()

height.description: Card height override. Bare integer = px (e.g. 200 = 200px). CSS units accepted: 200px, 50vh, 10em.

oneOf.description: Card width in pixels (bare integer, e.g. 300 = 300px)
Card width with CSS unit (e.g. 400px, 50vw, 10em) or a CSS function: calc(), min(), max(), clamp(), var()

width.description: Card width override. Bare integer = px (e.g. 400 = 400px). CSS units accepted: 400px, 50vw, 10em.

oneOf.description: Minimum card height in pixels (bare integer, e.g. 40 = 40px)
Minimum card height with CSS unit (e.g. 40px, 10vh)

min_height.description: Minimum card height floor. Overrides the --lcards-button-min-height CSS token. Bare integer = px.

oneOf.description: Minimum card width in pixels (bare integer, e.g. 80 = 80px)
Minimum card width with CSS unit (e.g. 80px, 10vw)

min_width.description: Minimum card width floor. Bare integer = px.

oneOf.description: Maximum card height in pixels (bare integer, e.g. 400 = 400px)
Maximum card height with CSS unit (e.g. 400px, 80vh, 20em)

max_height.description: Maximum card height ceiling. Bare integer = px (e.g. 400 = 400px). CSS units accepted: 400px, 80vh, 10em.

oneOf.description: Maximum card width in pixels (bare integer, e.g. 600 = 600px)
Maximum card width with CSS unit (e.g. 600px, 80vw, 20em)

max_width.description: Maximum card width ceiling. Bare integer = px (e.g. 600 = 600px). CSS units accepted: 600px, 80vw, 10em.

overflow.description: CSS overflow shorthand on the card host element (sets both axes unless overridden per-axis).

overflow_x.description: CSS overflow-x on the card host element. Overrides the overflow shorthand for the horizontal axis.

overflow_y.description: CSS overflow-y on the card host element. Overrides the overflow shorthand for the vertical axis.

z_index.description: CSS z-index stacking order on the card host element.

preset.description: Style preset name (mutually exclusive with advanced component)

component.description: Advanced SVG component name (provides the SVG shell)

attribute.description: Entity attribute to control (default varies by domain)

locked.description: Whether slider is read-only (auto-determined by domain)

invert_value.description: Invert value mapping (flip min↔max). When true, slider at min position sends max value to entity.

text.$comment: Text fields use arbitrary keys. "default" provides styling inherited by all other text fields. All other keys create actual rendered text elements.

default.description: Default styling inherited by all text fields (does not render)
default.$comment: This is NOT rendered as a text element - it only provides default styles

oneOf.description: Font size in pixels (1-200)
CSS value or theme token

font_weight.description: Font weight: CSS keyword (normal, bold) or numeric value (100–900)

font_family.description: CSS font-family (single font, comma-separated stack, or CSS variable)

display_format.description: Default display format for entity state/attribute tokens. "friendly" uses HA's translated display string. "raw" returns the unmodified value. "parts" joins value and unit. "unit" returns only the unit.

background_padding.description: Horizontal padding between text glyphs and the background rect edges (px).

background_radius.description: Corner radius of the background rect (px).

background_width.description: Fixed explicit width of the background rect (px). Overrides auto-sizing from text metrics. Text will overflow if content is wider than this value.

background_min_width.description: Minimum width of the background rect (px). Auto-sizes to text width but never smaller than this value. Safe for dynamic content.

font_size_percent.description: Default font size as a percentage of the card height. All fields inherit this unless they set an explicit font_size. Useful for bar-label style presets that should auto-scale with the configured card height.

cap_height_ratio.description: Ratio of the font cap-height to the em-square (font-size). Used to correct font_size_percent so visible glyph height matches the requested percentage of the container. Defaults to the theme token value (0.86 for Antonio). Override when using a different font family.

additionalProperties.description: Text field configuration (key becomes field name)
additionalProperties.$comment: Each key creates a separate SVG text element. Use descriptive names like "label1", "status", "title"

content.description: Text content. Templates are evaluated by default (set template:false to disable)

show.description: Whether to show this text field

x_percent.description: X position as percentage of card width (0-100)

y_percent.description: Y position as percentage of card height (0-100)

oneOf.description: Font size in pixels (1-200)
CSS value or theme token

font_weight.description: Font weight: CSS keyword (normal, bold) or numeric value (100–900)

font_family.description: CSS font-family (single font, comma-separated stack, or CSS variable)

template.description: Template evaluation is enabled by default for this field’s content (e.g. {entity.state}, {{ states(...) }}, [[[ ... ]]]). Set to false to render {...} / [[[...]]] text literally without evaluating it.

oneOf.description: true = stretch text to fill 100% of the available width
Fraction of available width to stretch text to (0–1)

stretch.description: Stretch text to fill a fraction of the available width using SVG textLength / lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs". true = 100%, 0.8 = 80%.

font_size_percent.description: Font size as a percentage of the text area height (component mode). Overrides font_size when set.

cap_height_ratio.description: Ratio of the font cap-height to the em-square. Used to correct font_size_percent so visible glyph height matches the requested percentage. Defaults to the theme token value (0.86 for Antonio). Override when using a different font.

zone.description: Named zone key to route this text field to. For component cards this matches a key in the component's zones map. For slider/elbow cards this matches a named layout zone (e.g. left, track, vertical_bar). Defaults to the first zone if not set.

display_format.description: How to format entity state or attribute values in this text field. "friendly" (default) uses HA's translated display string matching native cards. "raw" returns the unmodified state/attribute value. "parts" joins value and unit from HA's ToParts API. "unit" returns only the unit portion.

background_padding.description: Horizontal padding between text glyphs and the background rect edges (px).

background_radius.description: Corner radius of the background rect (px).

background_width.description: Fixed explicit width of the background rect (px). Overrides auto-sizing from text metrics. Text will overflow if content is wider than this value.

background_min_width.description: Minimum width of the background rect (px). Auto-sizes to text width but never smaller than this value. Safe for dynamic content.

display.description: Visual display range configuration (what pills/gauge render). Defaults to control range if not specified.

min.description: Minimum value shown on visual scale (default: control.min)

max.description: Maximum value shown on visual scale (default: control.max)

unit.description: Display unit for labels (overrides entity unit_of_measurement)

type.description: Track visual style (pills = segmented, gauge = ruler, shaped = solid fill inside a clip-path shape)
enumDescriptions: Solid fill clipped to a shape boundary (use with component: shaped)

oneOf.description: Track height in pixels
CSS value or theme token
Track margin in pixels (applies to all sides)
Per-side margin configuration

orientation.description: Slider orientation - affects track rendering direction

invert_fill.description: Invert visual fill direction. When true, fills from opposite end (right/top instead of left/bottom).

count.description: Number of pill segments (or "auto" to calculate based on size)

oneOf.description: Gap between pills in pixels
CSS value or theme token
Border radius in pixels
CSS value or theme token

size.description: Pill dimensions (width for horizontal, height for vertical)

width.description: Fixed width of each pill in horizontal mode (pixels)

height.description: Fixed height of each pill in vertical mode (pixels)

padding.description: Padding to offset from aligned position

background.description: Background track drawn behind the progress bar fill, clamped to control range. Leave unset for no background.

color.description: Background track colour. Supports state-based maps.

start.description: Radius on start end (left for horizontal, bottom for vertical)

end.description: Radius on end (right for horizontal, top for vertical)

show_unit.description: Show unit suffix on scale labels. Set false to hide even when entity has unit_of_measurement.

unit.description: Unit suffix for labels. Takes priority over entity unit_of_measurement.

enabled.description: Show/hide current value indicator. Also accepts a Jinja2/JS template string resolving to a boolean (e.g. "{{ not is_state('sensor.x', 'unavailable') }}") for state-driven visibility.

width.description: Indicator width in pixels (or rx for round type)

height.description: Indicator height in pixels (or ry for round type)

rotation.description: Rotation angle in degrees (for triangle type)

offset.description: Position offset relative to progress bar end

marker_indicator.description: Default shape for value-marker indicators (ranges with a "value" key). Overrides global defaults for this preset/component. Can still be overridden per-range via the range's own "indicator" block. Defaults: type=triangle, size=20×20, rotation=180.

align.description: Cross-axis alignment within the track zone. start=left edge (vertical)/top (horizontal), center=middle, end=right/bottom. Use start on Picard to pin the marker to the tick column regardless of card width.

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees (default: 180, triangle points toward ticks)

offset.description: Fine-tune position within the track zone after align is applied. offset.x=minorHeight+trimWidth (default 20) places the triangle tip at the outer edge of minor ticks when align=start.

border.description: Per-side border configuration with optional corner radius

oneOf.description: Uniform corner radius in pixels applied to all four card corners
CSS variable or px/rem value for uniform corner radius, resolved at render time
Per-corner radius: use to round only specific corners (e.g. only the free end on a bordered LCARS slider). Each corner also accepts a CSS variable string.

radius.description: Corner radius: number or CSS variable string for uniform rounding, or per-corner object. Supports var(--ha-card-border-radius), px values, and rem values.

range.description: Visual styling for range-band frame/border elements (used by components like Picard that render a decorative frame around the ranges track).

frame.description: Range track frame styling (decorative outline, e.g. Picard component)

color.description: Range frame colour. Falls back to the top border colour if unset.

solid_bar.description: Solid value-bar styling (used by components with a dedicated solid-bar zone, e.g. Picard).

color.description: Solid bar colour. Falls back to the top border colour if unset.

animation.description: Styling for the built-in scanning/activity animation indicator (used by components like Picard/Demo).

ranges.description:
Colour-coded value ranges and point markers.

Two item types:
• Band range (min+max): coloured background zone, rect in gauge mode, segment overrides in pills mode.
• Value marker (value): live point indicator, triangle on gauge ticks, highlighted pill in pills mode.

min/max/value resolve static numbers, {entity.state}/{entity.attributes.x}/{states.domain.object_id.state} tokens, {datasource:name}, {config.x}/{variables.x} tokens, theme token references, and [[[JS]]], evaluated synchronously (no Jinja2; see range.label.text for full Jinja2/DataSource async support on the label caption).

min.description: Range start value (in display space). Supports static numbers or templates: {entity.state}, {entity.attributes.xxx}, {states.domain.object_id.state}, {datasource:name}, {config.x}, {variables.x}, [[[JS return expr]]]. (Synchronous only; no Jinja2.)

max.description: Range end value (in display space). Supports static numbers or templates: {entity.state}, {entity.attributes.xxx}, {states.domain.object_id.state}, {datasource:name}, {config.x}, {variables.x}, [[[JS return expr]]]. (Synchronous only; no Jinja2.)

opacity.description: Band opacity (0=transparent, 1=solid). Default 0.3 in gauge mode, 1 for the shaped and ring components.

value.description: Numeric value or template resolving to a position on the track. When present (instead of min/max), renders a point marker rather than a coloured band. Supports {entity.state}, {entity.attributes.xxx}, {states.domain.object_id.state}, {datasource:name}, {config.x}, {variables.x}, and [[[JS]]] templates. (Synchronous only; no Jinja2.)

indicator.description: Per-marker indicator shape. Gauge mode: fallback chain this block → style.gauge.marker_indicator (preset default) → hardcoded defaults (triangle 20×20, rotation 180, no border). Ring (component: ring): type line (default, a radial line from the inner edge past the ring), triangle (outside the ring, pointing at it) or round (a dot on the band); align start/center/end anchors it at the inner edge, the band middle or the outer edge; size, color, border and offset.y (radial shift, positive outward) apply; rotation follows the ring.

align.description: Cross-axis alignment: start=left/top edge, center=middle, end=right/bottom. Overrides the preset marker_indicator.align for this range only.

color.description: Indicator fill color (defaults to range color). Supports state-object syntax ({ active, inactive, above:N, … }) and theme:/var()/computed colour tokens.

enabled.description: Draw an outline on the marker (default false)

pill_style.description: Pills mode: visual appearance of the marker pill.

stroke.description: Show an outline border on the marker pill to distinguish it from neighbours

stroke_color.description: Outline border colour. Falls back to the pill fill colour (range.color) if unset.

label.description: Optional text caption shown next to the marker (gauge mode), the highlighted pill (pills mode) or outside the ring beyond the marker (ring).

text.description: Label text. Supports the full template system: {entity.attributes.xxx} / {states.entity_id.state} tokens, {{ Jinja2 }}, [[[ JS ]]], and {datasource:name} references, or a plain static string.

color.description: State-based colour of the label text. Falls back to theme:components.slider.indicator.label.color.

font_size.description: Label font size in pixels. Defaults to the gauge tick-label size.

offset.description: Pixel offset from the marker’s default label position (above the marker in horizontal orientation, beside it in vertical).

ring.description: Ring gauge configuration (used with component: ring). Angles are in degrees, 0 = top, clockwise; the value arc fills from start_angle to end_angle.

start_angle.description: Angle where the ring starts (the minimum), in degrees: 0 = top, 90 = right, -90 = left. Default -135.

end_angle.description: Angle where the ring ends (the maximum), in degrees, clockwise from start_angle. An end at or before the start wraps round; equal angles draw a full ring. Default 135 (a 270 degree sweep with the gap at the bottom).

oneOf.description: Thickness in pixels
Percentage of the ring diameter (e.g. 12%) or pixels (e.g. 14px)

thickness.description: Ring band thickness: a percentage of the ring diameter (e.g. 12%) or pixels (a number or e.g. 14px). Default 12%.

cap.description: Ends of the track and value arcs: round or flat. Default round.

track.description: The unfilled ring (the whole sweep, under the value arc)

color.description: Track colour. Supports state-object syntax and theme:/var()/computed colour tokens. Default theme:components.slider.ring.track.color.
Value arc colour. Supports state-object syntax ({ active, inactive, above:N, ... }) and theme:/var()/computed colour tokens. Default theme:components.slider.ring.fill.color.

scale.description: Ticks and value labels outside the ring: the same keys as style.gauge.scale. A tick level, or the labels, shows when its block is set.

tick_marks.description: Major and minor tick marks at value intervals

major.description: Major ticks. Shown when this block is set (enabled defaults to true).

enabled.description: Show the major ticks (default true once the block is set)

interval.description: Value units between major ticks, counted from the display minimum (default 10)

height.description: Tick length in pixels, outward from the ring (default 8)

minor.description: Minor ticks. Shown when this block is set (enabled defaults to true).

enabled.description: Show the minor ticks (default true once the block is set)

interval.description: Value units between minor ticks, counted from the display minimum (default 2)

height.description: Tick length in pixels, outward from the ring (default 4)

labels.description: Value labels at the major tick interval (tick_marks.major.interval, default 10). Shown when this block is set.

enabled.description: Show the labels (default true once the block is set)

show_unit.description: Add the unit to each label. Set false to hide it even when the entity has a unit.

unit.description: Unit suffix for the labels. Takes priority over the display unit and the entity unit_of_measurement.

padding.description: Gap between the ticks and the labels in pixels (default 3)

focus_ring.description: Outline the ring while it has keyboard focus (default false: most rings are used by touch). Keyboard control works either way.

padding.description: Room left outside the ring for the scale, value markers and their labels, in pixels. Worked out from them when unset; set it to line up several rings or to give long labels more room.

shaped.description: Shaped component configuration (used with component: shaped)

type.description: Shape boundary for the clip path

radius.description: Corner radius in pixels: lozenge auto = min(w,h)/2, rounded default = 8

fill.description: Value fill appearance (the “filled” portion of the shape)

color.description: Fill colour. Supports state-object syntax ({ active, inactive, above:N, … }) and theme:/var()/computed colour tokens.

text_bands.description: Band sizes (pixels reserved outside the shape body for text fields)

background.description: Shape interior background colour (the “empty” portion). Supports state-object syntax and theme:/var()/computed colour tokens.

points.description: Array of [xPct, yPct] pairs (0–1) defining polygon vertices relative to shape bounds

path.description: Raw SVG path options (shape type: path)

translate.description: Wrap path in translate(bodyX, bodyY) so coordinates are relative to the shape body origin

animations.description: Visual animations triggered by user interactions or entity state changes

value_tween.description: Eases the gauge/pills track and markers between old and new positions on entity-driven state changes (does not affect direct drag interaction). Distinct from the animations array, which is trigger/preset based.

enabled.description: Enable value tweening. Automatically forced off when the OS-level prefers-reduced-motion setting is active, regardless of this value.

ease.description: anime.js v4 easing function used for the tween

targets.description: Which elements the tween applies to. All default to true.

track.description: Tween the gauge/shaped fill, the ring's value arc or the pills opacity sweep, whichever the card's track type uses.

markers.description: Tween threshold/range marker position (and, in pills mode, which pill is highlighted). Applies to `gauge`, `pills` and the ring: `shaped` never renders markers at all.

drag_badge.description: Live value badge that follows the drag position while the slider is being actively dragged by the user (never shown for entity-driven/external state changes). Mirrors HA's native slider drag badge.

enabled.description: Show a live value badge that tracks the drag position while dragging

format.description: Number formatting for the badge text

decimals.description: Fixed number of decimal places. Leave blank to use locale-default formatting.

show_unit.description: Show the unit suffix on the badge

unit.description: Unit suffix override. Leave blank to use the track's display unit (style.track.display.unit / entity unit_of_measurement).

offset.description: Pixel offset from the default anchor point (above the track in horizontal orientation, beside it in vertical).

color.description: Badge text colour. Falls back to theme:components.slider.drag_badge.text.color.

enabled.description: Show a background chip behind the badge text

color.description: Badge background colour. Falls back to a theme-aware translucent surface colour.

enabled.description: Show a border around the badge

color.description: Badge border colour. Falls back to theme:components.slider.border.color.default.

release.description: What happens to the badge when the drag is released (pointer-up), before the entity commit.

behavior.description: fade = linger briefly then fade out; instant = hide immediately on release. Automatically forced to instant when prefers-reduced-motion is active.

duration.description: Fade-out duration in milliseconds (only used when behavior = fade)

grid_options.description: Home Assistant grid layout options. Controls how many rows and columns this card occupies in the dashboard grid.

oneOf.description: Set to "full" to span all available columns
Number of columns this card spans (1-24)

columns.description: Number of columns (1-24) or "full" to span all columns

rows.description: Number of rows this card spans (1-100)

actionSchema.description: Action to perform on interaction (tap, hold, or double-tap). Supports toggle, service calls, navigation, more-info dialog, or no action.

perform_action.description: Action to perform (format: domain.action); the current Home Assistant name for service

service_data.description: Data to pass to the service

navigation_path.description: Path to navigate to (must start with /)

lcards_slider_style_gauge_progress_bar_b.description: Single colour value applied to all entity states
lcards_slider_style_gauge_progress_bar_b.title: Simple Colour
State-Dependent Colours
lcards_slider_style_gauge_progress_bar_b.description: Map of entity state names to colour values. Well-known keys: default, active, inactive, unavailable, zero, non_zero, hover, pressed. Any custom state name (e.g. "heating", "above:90") is also accepted.
Fallback colour when no other state key matches
Colour when entity state is a non-zero number
Colour for a custom state key (e.g. "heating", "cooling", "above:90", "below:20")
Colour when entity state is numeric 0

oneOf.title: Uniform Padding
oneOf.description: Same padding on all sides (in pixels)
